description: What the suite of the final answer parts must notice: the runner stops recording where the model's words end (or records the wrong thing, in the wrong order, for the main chat's own text, in a list entry, for a failed run), a reader goes back to cutting the text (the worker's summary, the claim of agent_results), a sentence of the Hub's is not kept apart or not bounded, a record is trusted that does not make the text it came with, the worker's hook note is dropped on its way to the page, and the next worker is handed the Hub's sentences as its predecessor's words (or loses them, or has them unbounded, or has no line that says whose they are), and the handoff to the other transport and the preview on the card of a workflow take the text whole again, or lose, or do not bound, or mix up the Hub's sentences they tell apart. M29 is a control: a changed comment must survive.

mutations.name: M1
mutations.what: the text puts the hook's note before the verification notice

mutations.name: M2
mutations.what: the text leaves the hook's note out: the page would not show it at all

mutations.name: M3
mutations.what: a record is trusted whatever text it came with

patches.old: return typeof view.finalText === 'string' && composeFinalText(record) === view.finalText ? record : null;

mutations.name: M4
mutations.what: a record whose notices are not strings is trusted when it happens to make the text

mutations.name: M5
mutations.what: the wording of the verification sentence changes (a reader that looks for the old one, and every page, would disagree with the runner)

patches.old: `DatGold has NOT independently verified full completion: ${missing.join('; ')}.`
patches.new: `DatGold has not independently verified full completion: ${missing.join('; ')}.`

mutations.name: M5b
mutations.what: the wording a task saved before the product was renamed ends with changes (a task saved by an earlier Hub would no longer be found)

patches.old: `ChatMCP has NOT independently verified full completion: ${missing.join('; ')}.`
patches.new: `ChatMCP has not independently verified full completion: ${missing.join('; ')}.`

mutations.name: M6
mutations.what: the runner records the whole text as the model's words

mutations.name: M7
mutations.what: the runner hands the record to nobody: it is not part of the public task

mutations.name: M8
mutations.what: the summary entries of a list carry the record: the model's words twice, next to a text that is clipped

mutations.name: M9
mutations.what: the runner appends the hook's note to the text but does not record it

mutations.name: M10
mutations.what: the guard in the public task and every reset of the record are gone: a failed run shows the record of the run before it

patches.old: task.status = 'paused'; task.finishedAt = now(); task.finalText = ''; task.finalParts = null;
task.finishedAt = null; task.finalText = ''; task.finalParts = null; task.error = null;

mutations.name: M11
mutations.what: only the guard in the public task is gone: the resets still empty the record whenever the text is emptied
mutations.equivalent: the resets and the guard each keep a record of an earlier run from being shown; M10 removes both and is killed

mutations.name: M12
mutations.what: only the resets are gone: the guard in the public task still hides the record while the text is empty
mutations.equivalent: the resets and the guard each keep a record of an earlier run from being shown; M10 removes both and is killed

patches.old: task.status = 'paused'; task.finishedAt = now(); task.finalText = ''; task.finalParts = null;
task.finishedAt = null; task.finalText = ''; task.finalParts = null; task.error = null;

mutations.name: M13
mutations.what: a worker's summary goes back to cutting the text

mutations.name: M14
mutations.what: a worker's summary is not bounded after the split

mutations.name: M15
mutations.what: the hook's note is not bounded on its own

mutations.name: M16
mutations.what: a worker's hook note is dropped before the worker's result is made

mutations.name: M17
mutations.what: the hook note is part of the result of a worker but is not stored on the worker the page reads

mutations.name: M18
mutations.what: agent_results goes back to cutting the text of a child

patches.old: const parts = raw === null ? null : finalPartsOf(d);

mutations.name: M19
mutations.what: the hook's note is read from the record but never reaches the facts of the child

mutations.name: M20
mutations.what: the hook's note is in the facts but not in the Hub's record of the answer

mutations.name: M21
mutations.what: the handoff of a predecessor goes back to its text whole, the Hub's sentences inside the result

mutations.name: M22
mutations.what: the verification sentence is dropped from the handoff

mutations.name: M23
mutations.what: the hook note is dropped from the handoff

mutations.name: M24
mutations.what: the result is the whole text although the runner recorded the words (the Hub's sentences are told twice)

mutations.name: M25
mutations.what: the hook note is not bounded

mutations.name: M26
mutations.what: the verification sentence is not bounded

mutations.name: M27
mutations.what: the model's words are not bounded

mutations.name: M28
mutations.what: the Hub's sentences follow with no line that says whose they are

mutations.name: M29
mutations.what: CONTROL: a comment of the module changes; nothing may notice
mutations.equivalent: only a comment of the module changes, so no behaviour can differ

patches.old: // The text a finished run ends with, and whose words are in it.
patches.new: // The text a finished run ends with, and whose words are in it (comment changed by the control).

mutations.name: M30
mutations.what: the handoff to the other transport lists the whole text of the last run as the model's answer again, the Hub's sentences and their marks in it

mutations.name: M31
mutations.what: the handoff to the other transport loses the Hub's sentences: no line of notes

mutations.name: M32
mutations.what: the line of notes in the handoff does not say whose sentences they are

patches.old: own notes about that answer (written by the Hub after the run, not by the model): '+notes.map

mutations.name: M33
mutations.what: the Hub's sentences in the handoff are not bounded

mutations.name: M34
mutations.what: the model's words in the handoff are not bounded

mutations.name: M35
mutations.what: the preview of an agent on the card of a workflow is the whole text again, the Hub's sentences and their marks in it

mutations.name: M36
mutations.what: the card of a workflow loses the Hub's sentences: no note beside the preview

mutations.name: M37
mutations.what: the Hub's sentences on the card of a workflow are not bounded

mutations.name: M38
mutations.what: a record is trusted by the readers of the handoff and the card whatever text it came with

patches.old: if (parts) return { words: parts.words, notes: [parts.verificationNotice, parts.hookNotice].filter(Boolean), recorded: true };
patches.new: if (view?.finalParts) return { words: view.finalParts.words, notes: [view.finalParts.verificationNotice, view.finalParts.hookNotice].filter(Boolean), recorded: true };

mutations.name: M39
mutations.what: the Hub's sentences are told in the other order: the hook's note before the verification notice
